audit.scope: Comprehensive localization, i18n, RTL, and theme audit across 52 routes, 9 sheets/dialogs, 6 registered locales (en, ur, ar, hi, ml, si), light/dark themes, and target viewports (393x852, 360x800)

tests.feature: Registered locale key parity and structural completeness
tests.steps: Parse en.json and the 5 non-English registered locales (ur, ar, hi, ml, si). Verify exact key count parity (2302 keys), zero missing keys, zero extra keys, and zero empty values.
tests.expected: Exact key parity (2302 keys), zero missing, zero extra, zero empty values across en, ur, ar, hi, ml, si.
tests.actual: All 6 registered locales have exactly 2,302 keys, 0 missing keys, 0 extra keys, and 0 empty values. Identical-to-English ratio is <= 1.17% across all 5 non-English files.
tests.notes: Meets rule 13 requirements for the registered locales.

tests.steps: Scan all registered locale files for exact matching of interpolation tokens ({{count}}, {{n}}, {n}, etc.) against en.json.
tests.expected: Exact token preservation without translation, renaming, or dropping per project rule 14.
tests.actual: Found 2 token mismatches in ar.json: 'Hizb {n} selected' and 'Juz {n} selected' use Arabic translated token '{ن}' instead of exact '{n}'. Handled by runtime workaround in src/lib/i18n.ts, but violates rule 14.
tests.notes: Rule 14 states interpolation tokens must never be translated. The token {ن} is translated from {n}.

tests.feature: Codebase translation key coverage in t() calls
tests.steps: Extract all string keys passed to t('...') across src/ and App.tsx, and cross-reference against en.json keys.
tests.expected: 100% of keys referenced in t() calls exist in en.json and registered locale dictionaries.
tests.actual: 159 keys invoked via t() in code are absent from en.json (e.g. 'NEXT PRAYER', 'Salah Today', 'UTILITIES & LOCATION', 'Structured schedules...'). In non-English locales, i18next returns the raw English key string as fallback.
tests.notes: Direct cause of widespread leftover English observed in Urdu, Arabic, Hindi, Malayalam, and Sinhala route crawls.

tests.feature: Onboarding screen language animation and setup flow
tests.steps: Load app in clean browser session without persisted state. Verify OnboardingScreen renders, title and subtitle cycle through demo languages (DEMO_CYCLE_ORDER), and tapping 'Get Started' persists onboardingDone=true.
tests.expected: Demo strings cycle smoothly every 1800ms with fade animation; selecting and tapping Get Started persists onboardingDone=true and navigates into main app.
tests.actual: OnboardingScreen rendered; text cycled across demo locales (English -> Arabic -> Urdu); Get Started button was clickable and persisted onboardingDone='true' to localStorage.

tests.feature: Instant language switching and storage persistence
tests.steps: Iterate across all 6 registered locales (en, ur, ar, hi, ml, si). Verify document.documentElement.lang updates, storage queue verifies write with readback, and reload restores persisted language.
tests.expected: Immediate language update, document.documentElement.lang matches active locale, islamic-settings storage persisted with read-back verification, and state survives reload.
tests.actual: All 6 registered locales passed: document.documentElement.lang matched selected locale, storage write-queue verified JSON payload, and full page reloads preserved chosen language.
tests.notes: Tested in 12 matrix runs across light/dark modes.

tests.feature: Instant theme switching (light/paper vs dark/ink) and persistence
tests.steps: Toggle between 'paper' (light) and 'ink' (dark) themes across multiple locales. Verify storage persistence and theme class/color changes.
tests.expected: Instant theme switch without page reload, correct background and text token application, and persistence in islamic-settings.
tests.actual: Both paper (light) and ink (dark) themes applied cleanly across all tested locales, persisted to localStorage, and survived page reloads.

tests.feature: RTL document direction and layout mirroring for Urdu & Arabic
tests.steps: Switch app to ur and ar. Inspect document.documentElement.dir and verify RTL text alignment and layout orientation.
tests.expected: document.documentElement.dir is set to 'rtl' for ur and ar, and 'ltr' for en, hi, ml, si.
tests.actual: document.documentElement.dir was 'rtl' for ur and ar, and 'ltr' for en, hi, ml, si. General flex container mirroring functions on web.
tests.notes: Native layout direction relies on prepareNativeLayoutDirection and app reload.

tests.feature: Logical padding and margin usage for RTL compliance
tests.steps: Scan component and screen StyleSheet definitions for physical directional properties (paddingLeft, paddingRight, marginLeft, marginRight, borderLeftWidth, borderRightWidth).
tests.expected: All asymmetric directional styles use logical paddingStart, paddingEnd, marginStart, marginEnd to ensure proper RTL flipping.
tests.actual: Found 44 files using physical left/right CSS properties instead of logical start/end properties (e.g. QuranAudioScreen: 17, QuranReaderScreen: 15, LibraryScreen: 14, ToolsScreen: 11).
tests.notes: Physical properties fail to flip in RTL locales, causing inconsistent icon spacing, misaligned chevrons, and unbalanced padding.

tests.feature: Script font loading for non-Latin writing systems
tests.steps: Inspect font loading definitions in src/lib/fonts.ts against registered non-Latin locales (ur, ar, hi, ml, si).
tests.expected: Dedicated high-quality typefaces bundled or loaded for Arabic (Amiri, Noto Naskh), Urdu (Nastaliq), Hindi (Devanagari), Malayalam, and Sinhala.
tests.actual: Only Amiri and Noto Naskh Arabic are loaded for Arabic script. Urdu lacks Noto Nastaliq Urdu (uses Noto Naskh fallback); Hindi, Malayalam, and Sinhala have no loaded Google web fonts and rely entirely on generic OS system fallbacks.
tests.notes: While system fallback renders the characters, typographic elegance is degraded for Indic and Sinhala scripts.

tests.steps: Inspect numeral formatting in prayer countdowns, hijri calendars, tasbih counters, and zakat calculators in Urdu and Arabic locales.
tests.expected: UI numbers are formatted according to the active locale (e.g. Eastern Arabic/Urdu digits when appropriate, or localized separators).
tests.actual: toArabicNumerals is only implemented for Quran ayah end-markers (۝). All other app UI screens hardcode Latin digits (0-9) for prayer times, dates, counters, and statistics regardless of the selected locale.
tests.notes: Standard practice in modern Arabic apps is often mixed, but complete localization should support locale digits or standard Intl formatting.

tests.steps: Simulate 40% string expansion on DOM text nodes at compact 360x800 viewport. Measure horizontal overflow (scrollWidth > clientWidth) across cards, pills, buttons, and headers.
tests.expected: UI components accommodate +40% text expansion without unscrollable horizontal overflow or broken layouts.
tests.actual: Simulation passed: 0 unscrollable overflowing containers detected at 360x800 viewport under +40% string expansion.
tests.notes: Flexbox wrapping and scroll containers accommodated the expanded text gracefully.
